notes.title: Content Update & Beta Branch Notice
notes.content:
Hello, this is joy1999.

Thank you for playing and enjoying Touhou Crawl.
We’re excited to share that a beta branch has been opened for new content!


[h2]1. How to Join the Beta[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547976/8ef8b34dc4130545a90f3f33f2e1486d5b7e3eb3.png[/img]
Right-click Touhou Crawl in your Steam library and select Properties.
In the Betas tab, change the Beta Participation dropdown to beta.
The current beta version is 1.201.

[h3]1.1 Beta Notes[/h3]

The beta branch will receive updates as new content is added, and may be unstable.
Save files are compatible from lower to higher versions, but not vice versa.
Be aware, your beta saves will no longer work after switching to the main branch.


[h2]2. New Beta Features[/h2]

[h3]2.1 Weapon-Type Specialization[/h3]
Previously, weapon types (except short blades) played similarly. Now each type has unique ability.

[h4]Axe[/h4]
Axes generate a shockwave when attacking, allowing you to hit the tile behind the enemy.
This makes battles in narrow corridors even more powerful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547976/a50d18d1d1275e7443bb922f67f7ad40d24f43cf.gif[/img]
Sorry about those who were expecting the original Stone Soup's cleave attack!



[h4]Mace[/h4]
Maces have a chance to deliver a Smash when attacking, dealing more damage and inflicting the Dazed status.
This damage scales with Strength, and Dazed reduces accuracy and magic use frequency.
In addition, when a Smash occurs, score items and P items are scattered around.
(P items are items that would drop upon defeating the enemy, generated in advance; score items are purely decorative.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547976/850ccef113327ad9342b77715eb22b7db18eb820.gif[/img]
Note that this attack must catch the target off guard, so any enemy hit once will become immune to it!



[h4]Polearm[/h4]
Polearms can attack enemies two tiles away.
Use in auto-combat or press v/V.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547976/96f99cd924db1a28676e342c87590ef795ddf66d.gif[/img]
(v now prioritizes Polearms; other evokables use V.)



[h4]Long Blade[/h4]
When no enemies are in adjacent tiles, long blades can slash away projectiles in half.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547976/196927ce0fea0023955ba98e5f0f7a8cb980f4fe.gif[/img]
Chance scales with Long Blades skill; requires at least level 8.



[h4]Short Blade[/h4]
Short Blades have no special abilities, but their base damage has been increased by 1 for balance with other weapons.
Short Blades are specialized for Backstab, so no additional special abilities are planned.
Specialized for Short Blades perhaps a character might join later…


[h3]2.2 Dungeon Suzunaan (Beta)[/h3]
For all the explorers struggling to find information in the dungeon, Kosuzu has opened a book renter!
The Dungeon Suzunaan is an in-game help feature that organizes hard-to-find information like a wiki.
In the Dungeon Suzunaan, you can look up spoilers that include detailed in-game stats.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547976/daaa90f7a1412d02cdc927fbf8e43bae8368d6ac.gif[/img]
Currently in beta: no search, limited entries, KR/EN only. More entries and Japanese support coming later.

[h3]2.3 Other Balance Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] G key can now trigger dungeon exploration.
[*] Increased base melee accuracy for warrior characters.
[*] Improved some translations.
[/list]

Sorry, Patch notes in beta branch may not be able to be posted every time!

[h3]2.4 Planned Beta Updates[/h3]

The big things currently planned for the beta branch are god balancing and additions,
character balancing and additions, new races, rotating and add new sub-dungeons, and a challenge system.


--------------------


The main branch will receive updates after testing in beta, unless a bug is game-breaking.
This is to keep the main branch stable and help prevent replay incompatibility.
If you want to try new content early, join the beta branch.
If not, you can wait for updates on the main branch.



Thank you again to everyone playing.
See you next time!

notes.title: minor patch - ver1.117
notes.content:
Feature Additions
[list]
[*] Added skill training focus via capital letters during skill selection
[*] Monster spell damage is now shown in dice format
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed issues related to saving
[*] Fixed a bug where monsters with 2-tile reach could attack through glass walls
[*] Fixed a bug where Haniwa could attack 2 tiles away without wielding a spear
[*] Fixed item generation by Haniwa to properly display the --More-- prompt
[*] Fixed virtual keyboard not appearing when searching for items in Steam Deck
[*] Fixed a bug where clearing the Arena did not drop a Yin-Yang Orb, preventing win (Sorry to anyone who cleared!)
[*] Fixed a bug where Suwako could occasionally gift Koishi's hat
[*] Fixed some evokable items being able to attack enemies out of range
[*] Fixed a bug where doppelgangers appear when playing Minigame 1 as the Three Fairies
[*] Fixed Momiji starting with a See Invisible ring instead of the See Invisible trait
[*] Fixed certain monsters being unable to follow you through stairs when affected by Yuyuko's Binding Soul
[*] Minor text adjustments
[/list]

Balance Adjustments
[list]
[*] Sunny’s invisibility activation chance is now always 100%
[*] Earth SpellCards can now destroy statues
[*] Fixed *Tele appearing too frequently on random artifacts; now more varied minor negative effect instead
[*] Reduced the chance of early-game artifact rings; increased the chance for artifact armor instead
[/list]

Thank you!
If you find any typos or translation issues, feel free to report them — I will fix them in the next patch!

Thank you for playing and enjoying the game!

notes.title: minor patch - ver1.115
notes.content:
[p]Bug Fixes


[list]
[*] Fixed an infinite loop that could occur when auto-moving in unreachable maps.
[*] Fixed an issue where sub-dangerous dungeons would show a warning every single time you entered.
[*] Fixed a bug where gloves' descriptions were showing up on boots
[*] Fixed an issue where summoned units could be stacked without limit by summoning them from other floors.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when using the right-side menu with a gamepad.
[*] Fixed a bug where Star would steal Sunny’s ability.
[*] Fixed an issue where only the first page of the online scoreboard was viewable.
[*] BGM volume has been slightly reduced.
[*] Minor typo corrections.
[/list]


Minor Balance Patch

[list]
[*] Greatly reduced the spawn rate of Cranes.
[*] Significantly reduced the Samurai’s attack damage.
[*] Slightly reduced the attack damage of cats.
[/list]

A more comprehensive balance patch will be coming later with more time and care.
For now, a few monsters that felt overly strong early on have been temporarily nerfed.

Thank you for playing and enjoying the game![/p]

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello, this is joy1999.
I'd like to share some updates about my current project.

Touhou Crawl is a very old fan game project that combines Dungeon Crawl with the Touhou Project. It's been around for nearly 15 years, although there have been long periods of inactivity.

While it may look like a minor copy of Dungeon Crawl, it was entirely developed from the ground up.

I recently decided to revisit this old project for fun and release it on Steam for free.

Originally, my goal was just to upload the existing game to Steam with minimal changes. But once I started working on it again, I found myself wanting to improve various aspects of the game.

Here’s what I’m currently working on:

[list]
[*] [b]Multilingual support[/b] - I’m refactoring the code to make it easier to add new languages. For now, I plan to include AI-assisted English translations.
[*] [b]Legacy code improvements[/b]
[*] [b]Mouse support[/b]
[*] [b]In-game options menu[/b]
[*] [b]Steam Cloud saves, leaderboards, and achievements[/b]
[*] [b]Additional sprints[/b]
[*] [b]Balance adjustments[/b] – The original version was intentionally easy, but it’ll likely be much more challenging this time.
[*] [b]New gods, races, classes, monsters, and more[/b] – as many as I can come up with
[/list]

...and more!

The current goal is to release the game sometime in Q3 2025, but since I’m working on it in my spare time, delays are possibl

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547976/06f2a7d0246611df255fb30ff63b168a64198eb3.gif[/img]


I hope to see you again at launch.
If you'd like to reach out to me personally, feel free to contact me on Discord.
